title: Implement date-aware candidate scope and law status
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
temporal.ts and temporal-scope.test.ts are uncommitted relative to site_revision. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of an ordinary git status unless it is already in the index.
As-of scope does not decide what binds conduct. applicability is not-asserted.
Boundary validity and law validity are evaluated separately. A law is current only when its own interval is in force and at least one named territory is a current place.
Territorial ids must name places in the graph. Administrative parents, territorial-coverage edges, and issuer links are not walked.
Geometry, distance, and boundary flags are not inputs. Exclusion and hole roles are reported and do not establish date scope.
A civil as-of date is compared as a calendar label. It is not reinterpreted as UTC midnight. A zoned instant is converted to the civil day of each source timezone before the partial-date comparison.

Partial dates use the jurisdiction interval rule: comparison is at the coarser shared precision, the start is inclusive, and the end date itself stays inside. A repeal or boundary end leaves the interval only when the as-of value is strictly later at that precision.

An unknown commencement, unknown repeal, unknown declared status, unknown amendment date, or unknown or invalid timezone is not current. An open repeal is a sourced statement that there is no end. It is not an unknown repeal.
Publication is not commencement. An amendment stays on its own field: it does not replace commencement and it does not repeal the instrument. Repeal is not stored as an amendment.

A declared status of historical or superseded stays that label and is not current, even when the commencement-repeal interval contains the date. A declared status that contradicts the interval is unknown rather than choosing a side.
A missing place or boundary clock is an unknown timezone, so that place is not current even when the civil interval would contain the date.
An approximate boundary can make a place current only when the place has no primary or disputed boundary. An unknown primary is not replaced by an approximate boundary.
A disputed boundary is omitted until its view id is selected. Selecting a view does not rank it above another selected boundary.
Inferred dates are comparable, matching jurisdiction intervals. Inferred is not treated as unknown.
The candidate walk stops at 20000 places, 20000 boundaries, 5000 laws, and 64 amendments per law. Omitted laws and amendments are not treated as current.
Duplicate law ids are not merged and are not current. A floating source revision such as latest or current is not current.

Jest is not on the sealed PATH. This worktree had no node_modules. A gitignored symlink named node_modules points at the identical package-lock install in workspace_c361ba4c396d_6649c8d8c46a and is left in place. npm prepends node_modules/.bin when it runs the test script.
